title: After 2 years doesn't work
text: After 2 years doesn't work. My unit worked for 2 years and now it doesn't work. I think it's a sensor issue which I learned has a 5 year warranty but I can't get in touch with the company - phone, email and FB messages don't work. I would not suggest buying this product.

product_metadata.title: Frigidaire 50-Pint Dehumidifier, Gray & White
description: Maintain optimal humidity in medium-sized rooms effortlessly with the Frigidaire FFAD5033R1 Dehumidifier. This Energy Star dehumidifier features many Effortless functions that simplify operation. These include automatic humidity control, continuous draining, a full tank alert system, automatic shutoff, auto defrost, and more. Plus, Energy Star operation means it helps save you money on energy costs.
